title: MPostbox
description: A fully configurable mail system that allows players to send items and messages to other players — even while they are offline.
body:
# MPostbox

MPostbox brings a modern and simple mail system to your Minecraft server!

With this plugin, players can send items and messages to other players — even if they are currently offline. Perfect for SMPs, survival servers, CityBuild, or community projects.

The plugin is fully configurable, performance optimized, and easy to use.

## Features

* Send items to players
* Works with offline players
* Simple and modern mail system
* Customizable messages
* Fully configurable
* Performance optimized
* No watermarks
* Modern GUI design
* Secure data storage
* Easy handling for players

## Why MPostbox?

* Perfect for SMPs and survival servers
* Encourages player interaction
* Easy to use
* Lightweight and efficient
* Modern design
* Optimized for modern Minecraft versions

## Use Cases

* Player trading
* Sending gifts
* Community events
* Offline item transfers
* SMP systems
